subject: Quick note about the www.clyne-bennie.co.nz website
body:
Hi,

I was looking at www.clyne-bennie.co.nz and noticed there's no contact form or email address, only a phone number, and the page code is unusually heavy, which slows loading.

I fix this kind of thing for local businesses. I'm not after a meeting — if it's useful I'll send you the specifics so you (or whoever looks after your site) can just get it sorted.

Worth me sending that over?
